publish_date_end_bound.expression:
CASE
    WHEN (((publish_date / 100) % 100) = 0) THEN (((publish_date / 10000) * 10000) + 1231)
    WHEN ((publish_date % 100) = 0) THEN (((publish_date / 100) * 100) + 31)
    ELSE publish_date
END

publish_date_start_bound.expression:
CASE
    WHEN (((publish_date / 100) % 100) = 0) THEN (((publish_date / 10000) * 10000) + 101)
    WHEN ((publish_date % 100) = 0) THEN (((publish_date / 100) * 100) + 1)
    ELSE publish_date
END
